notes: LIKEs CONCAT(SupplierName,' ',primaryContact.FullName,' ',primaryContact.PreferredName). Only PrimaryContactPersonID joins (supplier 1 -> person 4 Dan). Supplier 2 has NULL contact (null-contact branch).

cases.name: contact-name-match

cases.name: null-contact-name-match
cases.why: 'Contoso' matches supplier 2, which has NULL contact -> null-contact branch returns because CONCAT ignores NULL.
